title: ADV-1 advisory request
description: A non-urgent fleet decision handed to the Tier 1 roundtable (see starlifter-os/docs/ai-advisory-layer-draft.md). Only deliberative questions belong here: anything time-critical is Tier 0 and must never be sent to this layer. The sender names a defaultChoice that applies if no human approves a recommendation by decideBy, so the fleet is never blocked on the roundtable.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant, same shape as OTF-1 timestamps.

urgency.description: Fixed value: this layer only accepts deliberative (minutes-to-hours) questions.

context.description: Free-form structured facts the agents may reason over (positions, inventories, schedules).

defaultChoice.description: Must equal one options[].id (checked by tools/validate.py; JSON Schema cannot express it).
